uncertainty.explanation: cohort-003 and cohort-004 linked by identical source observations; not 18 independent trials
uncertainty.conditional_bound_scope: illustration only: assumes 2 independent identically distributed random source groups, not established here; bounds group-level any disagreement, not FPR or causal benefit
uncertainty.conclusion: no demonstrated improvement; zero observed difference does not establish equivalence

future_planning.status: proposal for new data only; not applied to current results
future_planning.primary: C2 FPR minus C3 FPR; require lower one-sided 97.5% paired CI > 0.05
future_planning.safeguards: upper one-sided 97.5% bounds on extra missed-positive rate (including refusals) and extra refusal rate <= 0.02; hierarchical pre-specified conjunction
future_planning.delay: secondary descriptive until independently annotated onset and censoring policy fixed
future_planning.design: one eligible negative pair per independent group for approximation; plan positive and quality strata separately
future_planning.caveats: planning approximation only; q and baseline FPR need independent pilot; cluster design effects/positive-stratum power/attrition require separate simulation before final recruitment

zero_event_example.interpretation: zero-event rate precision only; not proof of paired superiority
